item.title: Cofferly 0.5.1
item.description: - **Opens faster over most apps:** as it opens, Cofferly now asks which field you're in only of Chrome-based apps (Chrome, Brave, Edge, Slack, Asana and the like), of an app it hasn't met yet, and of one where it once found no field to fill; over the others it opens without waiting for an answer. - **A paste goes only where you meant it:** if another app came to the front while Cofferly waited (for Touch ID, say), nothing is pasted, and Cofferly says so. - **A new recovery key now also gives your history new keys,** so the old key can't open anything made since. If you replaced or removed a recovery key before, make a new one in Settings › Security; where Cofferly can tell, What's New takes you through it. - **Check your recovery key:** you can now check that the recovery key you kept is the current one, in Settings › Security, and once a year Cofferly offers to. - **What's New… shows what's new in this version,** and Cofferly's windows open in the middle of your screen at eye height, also when their content grows. - **Pick with the keyboard:** ⌘→ picks the item you're on and the next one, and one more with each press; ⌘← takes the last one off again. ↩ pastes them in order.
